mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyperuricemia may complicate abacavir therapy; abacavir metabolism may be affected by altered electrolyte status and renal function changes from thiazide diuretics.
action: Monitor serum potassium, uric acid levels, and renal function regularly; consider potassium supplementation if hypokalemia develops; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for abacavir hypersensitivity reaction.
